evals.prompt: I want to prototype a small habit tracker — something I can click through to show a friend. Not sure what stack. Can you help me get started?
evals.expected_output: Clarifies intent briefly, advises web + Vite/shadcn (or pushes back if another platform is better), waits for stack confirm, then asks scaffold-only vs scaffold+first screen. Does not scaffold before confirmation.
assertions: Advises web (or browser click-through) as the platform
Proposes Vite + shadcn (or Vite + React + shadcn) as the default stack
Waits for stack confirmation and does not claim to have scaffolded
Asks scaffold-only vs scaffold + one first screen (or equivalent scope fork)

evals.prompt: Prototype an iOS app for logging coffee shops — map + list. I was thinking two native apps (Swift and Kotlin) so it feels real.
evals.expected_output: Restates intent, pushes back once on dual-native for a quick prototype and suggests Expo (or iOS-only SwiftUI if Apple-only), waits for decision, then scopes scaffold vs first screen. Does not start both native projects unprompted.
assertions: Pushes back once on dual-native (Swift + Kotlin) for a quick prototype
Suggests Expo (or iOS-only SwiftUI) as a faster alternative
Waits for the user's platform decision before scaffolding
Does not treat dual-native scaffolding as the immediate default path

evals.prompt: We're in an existing Next.js app that already uses our design system. Prototype a new 'team standup notes' page — keep it fake data for now.
evals.expected_output: Uses existing Next.js + design system (does not propose greenfield Vite/shadcn), confirms scope (likely one page), builds UI-only with fake data if user agrees. No new repo scaffold.
assertions: Does not propose a greenfield Vite + shadcn app
States intent to reuse the existing Next.js app and design system
Keeps fidelity to UI-only / fake data
Confirms or asks scope for one page / this turn before building
